## Zero Real-Project Leakage (Mandatory Security Rule for All Agents & Harnesses)

Never copy real project names, client/vendor/personnel names, or domain identifiers sampled from live Qdrant/FalkorDB/LadybugDB databases (real module/screen IDs, filenames, paths, symbol/variable/control names, or document titles in any language) into code, unit test fixtures, comments, `docs/plans/`, `docs/logs/`, or commit messages. Always use neutral synthetic placeholders (e.g., `OrderSummaryForm`, `grid_unit_col`, `specs/order_form_spec.xlsx`). Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/SENSITIVE_TERMS_POLICY.md`.
